name: Replica Post Production
description: Consume the formal generation selection, target dialogue audio, target script and timing plan; conditionally run lip sync, then deterministically assemble episode video, formal audio and subtitles into a reviewed FINAL_OUTPUT candidate.
when_to_use: REPLICA has CURRENT GENERATION_SELECTION, TARGET_AUDIO, TARGET_SCRIPT and overflow-free TIMING_PLAN
when_not_to_use: Generation attempts have not been formally selected

steps.title: 校验正式生产输入
steps.description: 确认正式选片、目标音频、目标剧本和时序属于同一 CURRENT production lineage，且 Timing 无 overflow。

steps.title: 按需口型同步
steps.description: 只对 requires_lip_sync 的正式 selected segment 调用配置好的 Lip Sync Runtime；请求前必须持久化 ProviderJob。

steps.title: 确定性剪辑成片
steps.description: 按 production timeline trim/pad/concat，混入正式 Target Audio，导出 Target Script SRT 并形成待人工审核的 FINAL_OUTPUT candidate。

fact_levels: Formal video identity comes only from CURRENT GENERATION_SELECTION
Dialogue media comes only from CURRENT TARGET_AUDIO
Subtitle text comes only from CURRENT TARGET_SCRIPT
Dialogue placement comes only from CURRENT TIMING_PLAN
provider_rules: Lip Sync is conditional and must create ProviderJob before remote/runtime execution
FFmpeg post steps are deterministic local tools and must not create fake ProviderJobs
Provider output must be persisted, hashed and probed before use
Generated video audio is discarded; final dialogue audio is mixed only from formal TARGET_AUDIO
completion_criteria: Every formal selected segment is assembled in episode/segment order
Required lip-sync segments have real persisted ProviderJob provenance
Final episode video is ffprobe-valid and matches production timeline tolerance
Candidate is explicitly accepted before CURRENT FINAL_OUTPUT publication
failure_policy: Any stale lineage or timing overflow fails closed
Missing required lip-sync runtime fails closed
Failure or rejection does not overwrite previous CURRENT FINAL_OUTPUT
